postTitle: When the Default Plan Doesn't Fit You
topic: Many of the fixes are free; the common failure is not knowing the default exists

assumptions.notes: No figures. Three cost bands from the post: free (an evening), modest (a professional, e.g. a will or powers of attorney), hard (recognition gaps no document closes, handled with workarounds). The one hour audit has five lists.

bands.label: Hard
items: The right name from the start

hookVariants.narration: Many of the fixes for a household cost nothing. People skip them because they do not know anything is missing.
One evening shows which items need a form and which need local legal help.
The usual reason a household is unprotected is not cost. It is not knowing.

beats.narration: Fixes for a default that does not fit you come in three price bands.
Free, in an evening. Beneficiaries named on pensions and policies, where allowed. Who owns what, written down. Every account, listed.
Modest, and worth doing properly. A will. Powers of attorney. A written agreement about what you own together.
And hard: gaps no document closes, like a marriage your country does not recognise. There, the tools are workarounds, like insurance and a bigger buffer, checked under local law.

beats.narration: Many of the fixes sit in the first band. The usual failure is not cost. It is not knowing.
A first pass takes about an hour, with five lists. Accounts that pay out. What you own jointly. Who inherits with no will. Who could act for you. What you would lose with your job.

caption.instagram:
Many of the fixes for a household cost nothing. People skip them because they do not know anything is missing.

Fixes come in three bands. Free, in an evening: beneficiaries named on pensions and policies where allowed, who owns what written down, every account listed where someone you trust can find it. Modest, worth doing properly: a will, powers of attorney, a written agreement about what you own together. Hard: gaps no document closes, where possible workarounds include insurance and a bigger buffer, checked under local law.

The one hour audit: every account that pays out, what you own jointly, who inherits with no will, who could act for you, and what you would lose with your job.
